title: Add a real-title decision-card gate test in xtask decisions
summary: Add a unit test in xtask/src/decisions.rs, run by the normal cargo test gate, that loads every real proposal title from the repository's records (not fixtures) and renders a card for each under a time limit. It fails, listing each failing title, if a render hangs, or a question is empty, lacks a trailing '?', contains a jargon token, or is identical across different titles. Audience: the owner and later card-rule changes, which this test judges.

defaults_applied.how: fmt, clippy and cargo test criterion
helper tests with bad inputs prove the test can fail
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read xtask/src/decisions.rs (Brief::new, Brief::lines, check, html, locate, render, write, tests module at line 432) and grep of crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs. The card's question is the steward-stored OwnerBrief.question; the page never rewrites titles, so no generator of question-from-title exists yet. No new record file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord round trip is untouched.

Ambiguity: the 'question' for a title is taken from whatever the current card path produces (the stored brief question, or a question derived from the title if the queued third approach lands); the test calls one small seam so later card-text rule changes are judged by it. Real titles come from records (records branch / main tree work items) read through locate; the gate runs in a checkout where they are present.
Jargon token list is a new const in decisions.rs, seeded from terms the steward prompt forbids; exact tokens are the producer's choice and recorded in the test.
Environment: reads local git records branch and main tree only; no network, no pushes, no workflow changes.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) change; the test runs inside the existing cargo test gate.

acceptance_criteria.text: xtask/src/decisions.rs gains a #[test] in its tests module that obtains proposal titles from the repository's real records (via locate/check_record_file or the same reader the site uses), not from hand-built fixtures, and renders a card for each.
Each render runs under a time limit (e.g. a worker thread with a channel recv_timeout); a render that does not finish is recorded as a failing title instead of hanging the gate.

The test checks four properties per title: question non-empty, ends with '?', contains no jargon token from a named const list (seeded from the jargon the steward prompt bans, crates/athena-data/src/roles.rs:130), and is not identical to the question of a proposal with a different title. One assertion at the end panics with a message listing every failing title and its reason.

The checks are factored into a pure helper that small unit tests call with deliberately bad inputs (empty, no '?', jargon, duplicate across titles, a never-finishing render) and assert the failure message names the offending title, showing the test fails without the property.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: the new test and all existing tests pass; separately run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, which are clean (or the recorded same-tree checks per D115).
Non-test code behavior is unchanged: the diff outside #[cfg(test)] in xtask/src/decisions.rs is empty or limited to what the test needs to call; CHANGELOG.md records the job.
If the repository has no proposal records available to the test (empty list), the test fails rather than passing on an empty set (no-empty-success).

out_of_scope: Implementing or changing the third decision-card rewrite approach
Changing card text rules or the rendered page
Editing docs/decisions.md or anything under records/
departures: Ambiguity about how a question is produced from a title and dependence on real records being present raises rejection risk slightly.
urgent_reason: Cuts repeated rejected decision-card rewrites by gating them on real titles.
